description: Erection of a single storey rear wrap around and side extension, second floor rear extension with side dormers, replacement of all windows and front door, installation of roof windows on flat roof, repainting of the existing decorative plasterboard on the front elevation, erection of a replacement front boundary wall with railings and associated pedestrian and vehicular gates, installation of new hardstanding with existing dropped kerb, erection of bin store within the front driveway
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the north elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.
